func run(groups: [[Int]]) async throws {
 for batch in groups {
  async let rows = withThrowingTaskGroup(of: Int.self) { group in
   for item in batch { group.addTask { try await read(item) } }
   var rows: [Int] = []
   for try await row in group { rows.append(row) }
   return rows
  }
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
  consume(try await rows)
 }
 for batch in groups {
  async let rows = withThrowingTaskGroup(of: Int.self) { group in
   for item in batch { group.addTask { try await read(item) } }
   var rows: [Int] = []
   for try await row in group { rows.append(row) }
   return rows
  }
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
  try await inspect(batch)
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
  consume(try await rows)
 }
}
